steps.name: G04 deliberate RED and bounded descendant cleanup
steps.run:
set -eu
: "${G04_PROOF_TOKEN:?parent must bind unique proof token}"
sid=$(/bin/ps -p $$ -o sid= | tr -d ' ')
sh -c 'trap "" TERM; sleep 20' &
child=$!
printf 'G04_CHILD token=%s lane=%s pid=%s child=%s sid=%s pwd=%s home=%s tmp=%s cache=%s\n' "$G04_PROOF_TOKEN" "$CI_MATRIX_lane" "$$" "$child" "$sid" "$PWD" "$HOME" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"
if [ "$CI_MATRIX_lane" = A ]; then sleep 1; exit 7; fi
sleep 2
printf 'G04_PEER_DONE token=%s lane=%s\n' "$G04_PROOF_TOKEN" "$CI_MATRIX_lane"
